title: Generate initial 3D geometries
action: Convert each tautomer SMILES from tautomer_smiles.json to a reasonable 3D conformation using RDKit (or any other conformer generator) and save the structures to disk for the DFT step.
description: Build initial molecular geometries for all 15 tautomers.

title: DFT optimization and charge analysis
action: For each tautomer, perform DFT geometry optimization at B3LYP/aug‑cc‑pVDZ level using Psi4, compute Mulliken atomic charges, and calculate -Q_NO2 = Q_N + Q_O1 + Q_O2. Aggregate all results into nitro_group_charges.csv.
description: CSV file containing the computed nitro group charges for all 15 tautomers.
output_schema: columns: tautomer (string), q_NO2 (float). Exactly 15 rows, one per tautomer (ANTONO-1 through ANTONO-15).
